answer: A near-duplicate is rejected at the forge gate and the submitting identity is flagged, so one good text cannot be reused across aliases. Copying an answer as a result yields nothing, and producing 97 genuinely distinct answers per epoch is real inference work with real latency; the atlas ledger keeps the similarity graph, and the glacier review can re-run it. Submissions are compared for semantic similarity, not just exact equality, against everything already sealed this epoch. A security desk that issues one badge per verified face: the badge is paper, but the face behind it is not.
